weekend_race.race_comments: William Byron has won the DAYTONA 500 at Daytona International Speedway, his 14th victory in the NASCAR Cup Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty for the reason(s) indicated: No. 91 (engine change), Nos. 5, 6, 7, 35, 48, 54, 88, 99 (backup car), No. 47 (multiple inspection failures).
